# Tui Media

> Tui Media is a creative content studio in Nelson, New Zealand. It makes monthly social media video and photo content, and event videos, for businesses across Nelson, Richmond, Motueka, Tasman and Marlborough. Founded by Arlo Radford. Contact: hello@tuimedia.nz.

## Services

- [Monthly content](https://www.tuimedia.nz/monthly-content): one planned shoot a month becomes a month of edited videos and photos. Lite $450 a month (2 videos, 10 photos), Core $750 (4 videos, 15 photos), Full $1,200 (8 videos, 20 photos). Cheaper if paid quarterly. Two-month opening period, then month to month with 30 days' notice.
- [Event video](https://www.tuimedia.nz/events): an event filmed on the day and cut into a highlight film. $1,000 for up to four hours, $1,400 for a full day. Short social clips $150 each or three for $400. Second camera $400. No live streaming.

## About

- [About Tui Media](https://www.tuimedia.nz/about): a small Nelson studio. Over thirty Nelson businesses have used it, including builders, car detailers, a wildlife sanctuary and the Nelson Marlborough Rescue Helicopter Trust.
- [Home](https://www.tuimedia.nz/): overview, how it works, client reviews (5.0 from 14 Google reviews) and FAQs.
- Book a free 20-minute call: https://www.tuimedia.nz/#book
